concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-transaction-cancel-release-node]] - Braintree Marketplace-specific Node.js cancellation of a previously requested escrow release while `escrow_status` is `release_pending`, explicitly distinct from refund evidence
warnings: Preserve Braintree Marketplace merchant scope; do not generalize the operation to every Braintree merchant.
Retain both conditions: the escrowed transaction was previously released and its `escrow_status` is `release_pending`.
Keep cancel-release distinct from transaction refund or transaction cancellation; the raw does not state a buyer-funds effect or resulting escrow status.
The handlers show only generic result handling; do not infer result properties, success conditions or completed lifecycle outcomes.
